error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Lead name is required. [when string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Name)]; Valid contact number is required. [when request.Contact <= 0]; District is required. [when string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.District)]; Valid lead status ID is required. [when leadStatus == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token. [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; request body of type CreateLeadDto; passes 5 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.validations: Lead name is required.; Valid contact number is required.; District is required.; Valid lead status ID is required.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)
